wipro-05:
# Wipro's Water Management Targets

**Current FY25 Performance Against Targets:**

- **Freshwater Efficiency**: Target is 60% improvement by 2030 (from 150 to 60 Lpcd); achieved 50% improvement to date, bringing usage down to 75 Lpcd [Wipro, p.74]
- **Wastewater Treatment and Usage**: 100% of wastewater treated; 31% of total water requirement met from treated wastewater [Wipro, p.74]
- **Zero Discharge of Untreated Wastewater**: Maintained across facilities [Wipro, p.74]

**Revised Water Targets from FY26 Onwards:**

- To increase utilization of treated water to constitute 45% of total water use by 2030 [Wipro, p.74]
- To reduce absolute consumption of freshwater year-on-year by 3% in all operationally-controlled facilities [Wipro, p.74]
- Maintain Zero Liquid Discharge of untreated wastewater across all owned facilities [Wipro, p.74]
- Continue to treat 100% of all used water as per safe standards [Wipro, p.74]

Wipro notes that these revised targets were updated "based on a thorough assessment of current infrastructure capabilities and future feasibility" and reflect "a balanced approach" aligned with planned improvements in sewage treatment infrastructure [Wipro, p.73-74].

Based on the reporting year data provided [Wipro, p.79]:

**Recycling rate:** Wipro achieved a recycling rate of 97%, excluding C&D waste [Wipro, p.79].

**Waste diverted from landfill:** The table shows that out of total waste (excluding C&D):
- 4,833 tons (97.61%) were recycled
- 277.44 tons were prepared for reuse
- 3 tons were recovered through other methods
- **Total diverted from landfill: 5,113.44 tons (97.67%)**

**Waste sent to landfill:** 36 tons (0.73%) [Wipro, p.79]

Additionally, Wipro processed 100% of organic waste, with 90% being composted and 10% sent for co-processing or recycling [Wipro, p.81].

hcltech-01: According to HCLTech's Net Zero roadmap validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi), the company has a target of **a 42% reduction in absolute Scope 3 emissions by FY30**, measured against a baseline year of FY20 [HCLTech, p.54].
hcltech-02: According to the reports, HCLTech has committed to net zero by 2040 [HCLTech, p.65]. On this path, the company has established immediate targets for 2030, which were validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) to align with the 1.5°C pathway [HCLTech, p.65].
hcltech-03: HCLTech's renewable electricity target is to source **80% of electricity from renewable energy sources by the year 2030** [HCLTech, p.54].
hcltech-04:

hcltech-05:
Based on the excerpts, HCLTech has reduced water usage through the following measures [HCLTech, p.57]:

• **Technical interventions**: Water recycling plants, reusing AHU condensate and rainwater, and water-efficient measures
• **Fixture efficiency**: Water aerators installed in all wash basin taps; sensor taps installed in 98% of company buildings in FY24
• **Irrigation systems**: Automated irrigation systems with sprinkler and drip irrigation have reduced consumption
• **Wastewater treatment**: Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) with advanced MBR/MBBR technology treat wastewater, which is then repurposed for flushing washrooms and watering plants

**Results**: Since 2020, HCLTech has cut water usage by 40% in India [HCLTech, p.3]. The company has set targets of 5% year-on-year water consumption reduction for all owned facilities, with recycled water utilization fixed at 45% [HCLTech, p.57].
hcltech-06: HCLTech's goal is to eliminate waste to landfill at all owned facilities by FY25 [HCLTech, p.54], which is also stated as achieving zero waste to landfill at all owned facilities by 2025 [HCLTech, p.5].
hcltech-07:

hcltech-08: According to HCLTech, Scope 1 and 2 emissions have decreased by **25% compared to the FY20 baseline** [HCLTech, p.56]. In absolute terms, emissions fell from 224,094 mtCO2 in FY20 to 173,743 mtCO2 in FY24 [HCLTech, p.56].
